column2: a young man in his twenties in a plain dark hoodie, slumped low in an office chair, chin resting on his fist, staring blankly at the camera with a flat, unimpressed face, the back edge of an open laptop on the desk in front of him at the bottom of the frame
a woman in her thirties with shoulder length hair in a dark blazer over a plain top, shrugging with both palms turned up, eyebrows raised, a knowing half smile
a man in his forties with slicked back hair in a dark suit and open collar shirt, leaning toward the camera, tapping his temple with one finger, a sly knowing smirk

a man in his late twenties in a knit cardigan over a t-shirt, leaning far back in a desk chair with both hands behind his head, eyes closed, a completely relaxed grin, an open laptop on the desk in front of him at the bottom of the frame

a young woman with her hair in a claw clip, wearing a plain sweatshirt, holding a smartphone up toward the camera with the blank black screen facing the viewer and pointing at it with the index finger of her other hand, confident raised eyebrows
a man in his thirties in a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a loose tie, tossing a crumpled ball of paper back over his shoulder without looking, an unbothered, confident expression
a young woman in her twenties with her hair tied up, wearing a plain t-shirt, standing with her arms crossed, looking straight at the camera with a calm, small, sure smile
